criteria.E1: [D] entry load: steps 1–4 within ±10 % of body weight, steps 5–60 within ±1 %
criteria.E2: [S] entry: turf penetration ≤ 1 mm and joint separation ≤ 1 mm over the first 250 ms
criteria.E3: [D] entry: centre of pressure within 5 mm of the COM ground projection from step 5 (static equilibrium consistent)
criteria.E4: [D] entry: over 250 ms pelvis vertical change ≤ 1 mm, COM horizontal ≤ 2 mm, max key-axis drift ≤ 0.5° (no start-up transient)
criteria.I1a: [M/E] ankle K/mgh at the end of the 41.7 ms ramp (ankle intrinsic window 40 ms) within [0.5, 1.5] × Vlutters 2015, all 5 amplitudes
criteria.I1b: [M/E] ankle K/mgh at 71 ms within [0.5, 1.5] × Sakanaka 2021 for sub-degree rotations (no stretch reflex at sway size, Loram & Lakie 2002)
criteria.I2: [M/E] ankle quasi-static (held, 1 s) K/mgh within [0.13 (relaxed passive, Loram 2007a), 0.75 (1.5 × Kiemel 2008 intrinsic ≈ 0.5)]
criteria.I3: [M/E] hip quasi-static (held, 1 s) per side within [24, 111] N·m/rad (Kiemel 2008 intrinsic 95–147 both hips → 48–74 per hip × [0.5, 1.5])
criteria.I4: [E] knee quasi-static (held, 1 s) ≥ 17 N·m/rad (Riener & Edrich passive at 14°; lower bound only)
criteria.I5: [M/E] lumbar flexion fast (29 ms, trunk window 30 ms) elastic stiffness within [55, 164] N·m/rad (Brown & McGill 2009 intrinsic 109 × [0.5, 1.5])
criteria.I6: [M/E] lumbar lateral fast elastic stiffness ≥ 55 N·m/rad (Brown & McGill 2009: lateral ≥ flexion at every level; lower bound only)
criteria.P1: [D] small pushes (4 directions): no key axis yields within the 30 ms intrinsic window, and some key axis deflects ≥ 0.01° (resisted but compliant)
criteria.P2: [D] continuum: max key-axis deflection at 30 ms strictly increases small < moderate < large in every direction
criteria.R2: [D] release: ζ ≥ 0.05 where an oscillation is measurable
criteria.C1: [LIT-MODEL] eccentric hold (near-step 1° held stretch of the tonically active side): fraction of the stretch-induced strain torque remaining at 100 / 300 / 1000 ms within [0.25, 0.60] / [0.15, 0.45] / [0.08, 0.35] (ECCENTRIC_PERSISTENCE_DAMPING_LITERATURE §recommendation), ankle, knee, hip
criteria.INT: [S] joint separation ≤ 5 mm in every push run; no non-finite / speed stop in small and moderate pushes
criteria.DET: [S] bit-identical reruns (240-step standing, moderate forward push)
